name: GetSelectedCheckboxes
label: Get Selected Checkboxes
description: Retrieves the names of the selected checkboxes in a checkbox group or the state of a specific checkbox.

fields.name: IdentificationObjectPath
fields.label: UI Element
fields.description: The UI element which you would like to read the selected checkboxes from.

fields.name: MaxWaitTime
fields.label: Max Wait Time (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum time to wait to find the UI element (in seconds).

fields.name: SelectedCheckboxes
fields.label: Selected Checkboxes
fields.description: Returns the list of selected checkbox names.
